items.label: Sun Protection
items.value: The fabric is UPF 50+, protects your skin from the harmful UVA/UVB rays, keeping you cool and comfortbale during outdoor exercise and activities, which is great in hot weather

items.label: Lightweight Fabric
items.value: The jackets for women is cooling, breathable, soft, stretchy, and quick dry. It's lightweight, so it's convenient to add to a backpack or carry on bag. Washed and dried well

items.label: Well Design
items.value: The zip up jackets have a collar for protection on the back of the neck. Zipper garage keeps chafe in check. The raglan long sleeves have a thumb hole to fully protect from the sun, also keep the sleeves in place

items.label: 4 Deep Pockets
items.value: The pockets are excellent and deep. 2 zippered outside pockets ensure nothing slips out when closed, so no losing ID, keys etc. The inside deep pockets are great for anything from sunglasses to phone

items.label: Occasions
items.value: Workout jackets for woman are designed for versatility. Perfect for workout, athletic, hiking, travel, running, walking, fishing, cycling, golfing, biking, camping, sports, beach and all kinds of outdoor activities
